parts.notes: Plug-and-play RX and 6-pin HD VTX ports; XT30 pigtail included; ships with BLHeli_S, Bluejay flashable.

parts.notes: Built for 1S DJI O4 / Walksnail / HDZero whoops: SH1.0 6-pin HD VTX plug and a 3A BEC that holds down to 2.85V; 4.2 g with BT2.0 lead (3.8 g without). UART2 and UART4 free, UART1 RX-only (SBUS).

parts.name: GOKU F405 ERVT 1S 5A 5-in-1 AIO

parts.name: GOKU F405 HD 1S 5A ELRS AIO V2

parts.notes: Weight is without the A30 pigtail and VTX antenna.

parts.name: CrazyF411 ELRS 2-4S 20A AIO

parts.name: Specter F411 1-2S 10A AIO (ELRS + 400mW VTX)
parts.notes: SPI ELRS; ships with both XT30 and PH2.0 pigtails.

parts.name: Specter F722 AIO 40A 4-6S
parts.notes: F722 with MPU6000 gyro; combined HD/analog direct-plug port; only a 5V BEC.

parts.name: BLITZ Whoop F7 AIO V1.1 2-6S 55A

parts.name: LUX HD AIO G4 35A AM32 3-6S

parts.notes: Same board as the LUX HD G4 with motor plugs and a pre-soldered XT30 lead; the listing gives the weight only as 'just under 13g'.

parts.name: BeeBrain BLV5 1-2S 18A AIO (ELRS + VTX)

parts.name: Mamba MK4 F722 APP + F55 128K 55A Stack (30x30)

parts.name: GOKU GN405 Nano HD V3 ELRS + 20A Stack (16x16)

parts.name: TAKER F722 BT HD V3 + BL32 50A Stack (30x30)

parts.name: Kakute H7 V1.3 + Tekko32 F4 50A Stack (30x30)

parts.name: BLITZ F7 V1.2 + E55 55A Stack (30x30)

parts.name: BLITZ Mini F7 V1.2 + E55S 55A Stack (20x20)

parts.name: Hummingbird 200 RaceSpec Stack - AT32F435 ELRS FC + 80A AM32 (20x20)

parts.name: Hummingbird 305 Stack - F722 ELRS FC + 80A AM32 (30x30)
